remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2 half-bath townhouse tucked in the tranquil, wooded Silvermine Crossing community on the Norwalk/Wilton line. Perfectly blending recent upgrades with natural charm, this move-in ready home offers comfort, style, and convenience in a setting rarely found in condo living. Step into a sun-filled eat-in kitchen that is open to the living and dining areas that boast a cozy wood-burning fireplace and sliders leading to a private deck and garden -ideal for entertaining or relaxing in peaceful surroundings. Upstairs, the primary bedroom includes an updated bathroom and generous closet storage, while the second bedroom offers a walk-in closet and is perfect as a second bedroom or a home office. A newly refurbished second floor laundry completes the second floor. Community highlights include a pool, clubhouse with kitchen, pet-friendly grounds, and easy access to scenic walking paths and the Norwalk River Trail. Enjoy a commuter-friendly location near the Merritt 7 train station, Metro-North, top-rated shopping and dining, and major highways including the Merritt Parkway and I-95. This home truly checks every box-move in ready, private, and commuter-friendly. Don't miss your opportunity to make it yours!
